text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Done. Lightning ramen, served in seconds.
Consider this paying you back. Fast delivery, Umamusume Eats!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, that's way too fast! Nothing's been decided yet!
So why are you already trying to deliver it!?"
choice_data_list: More importantly, why is your way of returning the favor "ramen"?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It's simple! After all,
you remember what we saw back in Hakodate, right?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Seeing all the fans eating ramen so deliciously! Above all, they looked so happy—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ramen has that kind of power!
The power to cheer up all the fans!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There really are a lot of ramen shops inside racetracks, aren't there? So, you see, it got me thinking.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure everyone gets the energy
they need to cheer their hearts out from ramen!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I-I see?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that hard to accept?
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go lend a hand!
With the ramen event, that is!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And so, let's see just how many fans ramen can bring smiles to! Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
O-Oooh, yes sir...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You can't truly understand the value of ramen just by eating it as a customer. And so, everyone decided to participate in the event by helping out the stall.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Manager! That's the last
of the ingredients carried in!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Also, the line is getting pretty long,
so I'll go help manage the queue!
Hehe, everyone really loves the food here, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager A
text_block_list.text:
W-What incredible thoughtfulness... Hey, you.
How would you like to come work as my staff?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...U-Um, well... yes.
Thank you very much!
I'll think about it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um, this is "Menya Hanashibai"~. Nice to meet you~.

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! ...Hm?
"123rd Performance Starring TM Opera O.
A Waltz of the Moonlight and the Overlord: With a Touch of Doto"?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah!?
I brought the wrong flyers~~!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome. Step right up, you over there.
Behold, a ramen cart. Come and eat.
choice_data_list: ...Shouldn't we do more to show off what makes our shop unique?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
—This restaurant is full of straight lines. The noodles, the benches.
Even the owner plans to head straight home after the event.
choice_data_list: I-Is that supposed to be a selling point...?
I-Is that really a selling point, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after helping out at their respective shops,
Narita Top Road and the others gathered once more
during their break—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the foo-ood!"
"T-Thanks for the food..."
*sluuuuurp*

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"So deliciooous!"
"It's amazing!"
"Thanks for the food. *burp*"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"With every single bite, energy wells up...
Filling my entire body with pure happiness, you could say!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Can you feel it now?
This is the true power of the ramen I love so much!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's tasty enough to bring a smile
—to every single visitor's face!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right~ If we can deliver this to the customers... yeah. It made me want to do my best this afternoon too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Helping out is tough work, but... hehe.
With a reward like this, it really motivates me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm always so clumsy... and wasn't much
help at all, but... still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's so delicious...! It feels like it's comforting me,
even though I'm so useless...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, it is unfair that everyone else gets to eat such delicious things.
I shall buy seconds too. Even though my belly is bursting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Incredible... That was truly educational. Regarding ramen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes. By helping out, I was able to learn the basics of making ramen, and above all—

text_block_list.name: Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! So tastyyyy!
The curly noodles catch all that rich broth perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Customer C
text_block_list.text:
I mean, did you try the chashu pork too?
The flavor is soaked right through, it's so good! Man,
maybe I should've gotten the chashu ramen instead...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ Hey, Boss.
It looks like the ramen you made is a huge hit!"

text_block_list.name: Store Manager B
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... That makes me happy. Happy, sure,
but well, that's what I came here for anyway.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager B
text_block_list.text: —To make them say it's delicious with local flavors. That's our only goal.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager B
text_block_list.text:
For that, I brought Sapporo miso all the way here.
I brought local veggies, too. If this doesn't reach 'em,
I might as well close up shop. Gwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Every shop had its own local specialty and pride...
and poured it all right into their ramen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right! The Kitakata ramen shop I helped out at was just like that too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: They went out of their way to ship water from my hometown via courier... Their passion was truly incredible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"The Hakata ramen shop also makes its soup stock on-site...
Starting yesterday, it took half a day, you know?
Isn't that amazing?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Same here. She said she went out of her way to bring a commercial gas stove. Must have been heavy."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I see...
Because everyone puts so much care into it, it tastes that delicious...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See? Now you understand
how amazing ramen is, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It reminded me all over again
of how it has the power to bring smiles to everyone's faces!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ramen is just too damn good. In the end,
all it takes to please people is salt, fat, and carbs.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes... Even feeling down like I was, it brought a smile to my face... So I'm sure that with ramen, I can share my gratitude with the fans, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Honestly, at first, I did wonder,
"Why ramen?" But—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ramen sounds great.
It's not overly formal, but it still feels serious!
choice_data_list: I'll be supporting you from the shadows too! Do your best!
I'll support you from behind the scenes! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up to this point, I had mostly just gone with the flow,
but before I knew it—I made it personal.
And that was how I called out to them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I'm glad you understand!
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "For our fans, let's create unique ramen packed with the local specialties of each region!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Going that far is the only way to truly repay them!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right! I believe doing that is the only true way to deliver our gratitude to fans across the country!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even so, we couldn't handle things like the equipment or running the event ourselves, could we?
choice_data_list: I'll check with the Academy about that.
I'll check with the Academy about that.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wah! A ramen event sounds great!
Ramen is just so delicious!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Especially the bowl eaten right after work—the salt and carbs soak deep into your whole body—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Ah, forgive me! You were talking about work, right? ...*ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Academy has no reason to object to holding the event.
We, too, hope to provide our full cooperation.
choice_data_list: Thank goodness! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "However, our goal this time is to 'deliver our gratitude to fans nationwide.' If so, we need to do this on a larger scale."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So... yes! Would you mind leaving this matter in my hands for now?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I have a colleague who's especially dependable during events like this!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for coming all this way!
I was glad to hear what you had to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the one who appeared was Light Hello.
A capable event producer who happened to be
a former student of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the ramen event, absolutely!
Our company will give you our full backing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Having looked over the proposal,
I concluded that this is something we must do.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Because there was so much passion behind it, it made me feel that way! ...Right, Ms. Tazuna?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No, no♪
It's really nothing that grand~.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Well then, let's just go with that!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Now then. Moving on from there, I'd like to discuss specifically what we should do next—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: For now, our company plans to host a nationwide 'Ramen Event' at the end of each year over a three-year period.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I call it the 'Ramen Jamboree'!
At racecourses all across the country, we'll have local, specialty ramen prepared and served on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "Even so... developing a 'regional ramen' in Tokyo without truly knowing the region seems quite difficult, don't you think?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Apart from the "Ramen Jamboree"
――how about traveling around the country
as a "Ramen Training Journey"?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's a great idea!
A training journey! Let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: And to cap off the training, I was hoping to showcase the results at each place we visit...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice♪ But still, we don't even
know the first thing about ramen—we're just rookies...
Total rookie ramen shop clerks.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, during your training journey, rather than aiming for
a finished product to serve at the 'Ramen Jamboree'—be free.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make all kinds of ramen and learn all about it!
How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Yes!" "I'm fine~"
"Okey-dokey!" "I don't mind."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Well then, let's start with the
"Ramen Warrior Training"! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ei, ei, ramen!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
"Hip, hip, ramen!"
"Wait, what? How does everyone know how to respond to that?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began their new challenge—days dedicated to serving up "delicious gratitude."
